C0367.title: Beijing Education Company’s Scheduling System Breached via Password Brute-Force, Leading to Data Leak
C0367.summary: On August 1, 2023, a post on an overseas forum exposed over 700,000 order records from a Beijing-based education company. An investigation by Haidian cyber police found that the company’s academic scheduling system transmitted account credentials without encryption, making it susceptible to brute-force attacks.
